subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should channel senders be allowed to switch a conversation to another configured agent, and which allowlist, persistence, and workspace/tool access rules govern that switch?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses channel commands, routing, session state, workspace isolation, credentials, and tool policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
options.body: Add an opt-in session-scoped override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving per-agent workspace, memory, sandbox, and tool boundaries.

options.title: Keep Existing Paths
options.body: Treat static bindings, TUI `/agent`, `agents_list`, `sessions_spawn`, and `/focus` as the supported multi-agent workflows and reject direct channel switching.

options.title: Expose Plugin Seam First
options.body: Design a generic command/agent-picker SDK seam before any built-in channel implements visible agent switching.

recommendation.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in session-scoped override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving per-agent workspace, memory, sandbox, and tool boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal for multi-agent routing and agent discovery surfaces.
